# Introduction

## Data Collection Overview

The ProPELL study collected continuous physiological and activity data using **Polar Vantage V2** sports watches worn by participants throughout the 21-week study period. Data was extracted using the [Polar Accesslink API v3](https://www.polar.com/accesslink-api/#polar-accesslink-api){.external target="_blank"} and synchronized weekly via the Polar Flow platform.

## Watch Data Types

Five types of data were extracted from the Polar watches, resulting in 14 datasets:

| Prefix | Data Type | Datasets | Description |
|--------|-----------|----------|-------------|
| `wsl` | **Sleep** | wsl1-3 | Sleep stages, duration, and quality metrics |
| `wre` | **Recharge** | wre1-3 | Recovery status and autonomic nervous system metrics |
| `wda` | **Daily Activity** | wda1-3 | Daily activity summaries and step counts |
| `wex` | **Exercise** | wex1-4 | Individual workout sessions and training data |
| `whr` | **Heart Rate** | whr1 | Continuous heart rate measurements |

::: info-box
**Data Availability:** Watch data is available in the [ProPELL Data Hub](https://cloud.uni-konstanz.de/index.php/f/128545600){.external target="_blank"}. All datasets use anonymized participant IDs and can be joined as necessary.
:::

## Anonymized Participant IDs

Participant identifiers in watch datasets are anonymized and consistent with survey data identifiers. 

**Variable:** `id`

**Type:** Categorical

**Description:** Anonymized participant identifier assigned during data processing. These IDs replace the original pseudonymized codes (e.g., IKTENT20) to ensure full anonymization.

**Values:** Sequential numeric IDs from 1 to 75

The mapping between anonymized and pseudonymized IDs is restricted to authorized principal investigators and available [here](https://cloud.uni-konstanz.de/index.php/f/130413290){.external target="_blank"} (login required).

### Activity and Exercise IDs

Daily activity and exercise datasets include additional identifier variables:

- **`wda*_activity`**: Hash-transformed Polar activity IDs for daily summaries
- **`wex*_exercise`**: Hash-transformed Polar exercise IDs for workout sessions

These IDs enable merging of related datasets while maintaining participant anonymity.

## Variable Naming Convention

Watch variables follow a consistent naming pattern:

**Format:** `<prefix>_<descriptor>`

- **Prefix** indicates the dataset and data type (wsl, wre, wda, wex, whr)
- **Descriptor** identifies the specific measurement

*Examples:*
- `wda1_steps` = active steps from daily activity data
- `wsl1_duration` = total sleep duration
- `wex1_calories` = calories burned during exercise session
- `whr1_hr` = heart rate value (beats per minute)

# Sleep

This section contains data about participants' sleep. These data are available when the watch was worn during the night and participants slept for at least four hours.

* [wsl1]{.mf} contains general sleep data
* [wsl2]{.mf} contains sleep stages samples
* [wsl3]{.mf} contains heart rate samples



It can be used together with dates or activity and exercise ids to merge the datasets.


## [wsl1]{.mf}

```{r wsl1-data}
#| echo: false
data <- import(paste0(import_path, "/wsl1.rds"), trust = TRUE)
```

Dataset [wsl1]{.mf} contains information about participants' night sleep (e.g., total sleep duration). Each observation corresponds to one recorded night of a specific participant. Here's a quick glimpse of the dataset:

```{r wsl1-glimpse}
#| echo: false
glimpse(data)
```

@wsl1-figure shows how many rows (i.e., nights) each ProPELL participant has contributed to the dataset. The numbers vary due to, for instance, differences in the duration of the study (e.g., dropouts) and compliance with the instructions to wear the watch during the night.

```{r wsl1-figure}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: Number of nights measured for each participant
#| fig-height: 15

data_plot <- data %>%
  count(id)

ggplot(data_plot, aes(id, n)) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black",
           fill = usecol(pal_unikn_pref, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = rev) +
  labs(y = "\n# Nights", x = "Anonymized Participant ID\n",  caption = copyright_note) +
   theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
          text = element_text(family = monofam))
```

The remainder of this section describes all variables in the dataset.

```{r wsl1}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

render_survey("wsl1", data)

```

---

# Activity

## [wda1]{.mf}

```{r wda1-data}
#| echo: false
data <- import(paste0(import_path, "/wda1.rds"))
```

Dataset [wda1]{.mf} contains aggregate general information about physical activity for each day on which the Polar watch was worn (e.g., number of active steps). Each observation corresponds to one day of a specific participant. Here's a quick glimpse of the dataset:

```{r wda1-glimpse}
#| echo: false

```

@fig-wda1 shows how many rows (i.e., days) each participant in ProPELL has contributed to the dataset. The numbers vary because of differences between participants in the duration of the study and compliance with the instructions to wear the watch during the day.

```{r wda1-figure}

#| fig-cap: Number of nights measured for each participant
#| fig-height: 15

data_plot <- data %>%
  count(id)

  coord_flip() +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black",
           fill = usecol(pal_unikn_pref, 1)) +

  labs(y = "\n# Rows/Days", x = "Anonymized Participant ID\n",  caption = copyright_note) +
   theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
          text = element_text(family = monofam))
```

The remainder of this section describes all variables in the dataset.

# Exercise

This section contains data about participants' exercises. These data are available when an exercise was recorded with the watch.

* [wex1]{.mf} contains general information about the exercise
* [wex2]{.mf} contains information about heart rate zones
* [wex3]{.mf} contains information about heart rates
* [wex4]{.mf} contains information about R-R intervals

## [wex1]{.mf}

```{r wex1-data}
#| echo: false
data <- import(paste0(import_path, "/wex1.rds"))
```

Dataset [wex1]{.mf} contains information about exercises participants performed (e.g., duration of the exercise). Each observation corresponds to one exercise recorded with the Polar watch. Here's a quick glimpse of the dataset:

```{r wex1-glimpse}
#| echo: false
glimpse(data)
```

@fig-wex1 shows how many rows (i.e., exercises) each participant in ProPELL has contributed to the dataset.

```{r wex1-figure}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: Number of exercises recorded by each participant
#| fig-height: 15

data_plot <- data %>%
  count(id)

ggplot(data_plot, aes(id, n)) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black",
           fill = usecol(pal_unikn_pref, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = rev) +
  labs(y = "\n# Rows/Days", x = "Participant ID\n",  caption = copyright_note) +
   theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
          text = element_text(family = monofam))
```

The remainder of this section describes all variables in the dataset. 


# Heart rate

This section contains the continuous heart rate data. These data are available when the watch is worn. The watch takes regular samples and will start the continuous measurement when the heart rate is elevated or wrist movements are detected. It switches back from continuous to regular tracking when the activity level drops.

* [whr1]{.mf} contains the continuous heart rate data.

## [whr1]{.mf}

```{r whr1-data}
#| echo: false
data <- import(paste0(import_path, "/whr1.rds"))
```

Dataset [whr1]{.mf} comprises `r format(nrow(data), nsmall = 1, big.mark = ",")` observations of `r ncol(data)` variables. Each observations corresponds to one heart rate sample of a participant. Here's a quick glimpse of the dataset: 

```{r whr1-glimpse}
#| echo: false
glimpse(data)
```

The remainder of this section describes all variables in the dataset. 

```{r whr1}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

render_survey("whr1", data)

```
